mission: For 140 years, The Children’s Charity has been here for young people when they most need support. Today, we’ve never been more determined to create a society built for all children. We draw on our experience and expertise; by listening to and empowering young people throughout teenhood. We collaborate tirelessly, building a movement with everyone who shares our vision. Because every child deserves to feel hopeful, happy and excited for their future.
values: working directly with thousands of young people to give them the support they need, as soon as they need it
campaigning fearlessly to improve the systems for many hundreds of thousands more
building a movement, inspiring, informing, and changing attitudes.
strategy: Target people aged 30-50 with a strong interest in improving children's emotional health and wellbeing, their safety, and the circumstances they're growing up in.
target_audience: People in the UK aged 30-50, inclined to donate to charities
